records.text: The alleged sewing together of twins by Josef Mengele did not happen.
records.speaker: Auschwitz Memorial Podcast Speaker

appearances.snippet: I want to note that many myths arose around Mengele in the camp, such as the alleged sewing together of twins, which did not happen, simply because Mengele saw himself as a scientist, a theoretician, a man conducting research.

verification.notes: The Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial official educational podcast transcript directly states that the story of Mengele sewing twins together was a camp myth and did not happen. This confirms the narrow claim while not minimizing Mengele documented lethal experiments and abuse.

sources.title: Doctor Josef Mengele and his experiments in the camp | Auschwitz-Birkenau
sources.relevance: Official Auschwitz Memorial transcript says the alleged sewing together of twins did not happen.

records.text: The legend that Josef Mengele sewed twins together likely arose from transfusions performed on twins without cross-matching.
records.speaker: Auschwitz Memorial Podcast Speaker

appearances.snippet: So where did this legend come from? It likely originated from the fact that Mengele performed transfusions on twins without prior cross matching tests.

verification.notes: The Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial official transcript says the legend likely arose from Mengele transfusions on twins without prior cross-matching, during which children were connected by needles and tubes rather than sewn together.

sources.title: Doctor Josef Mengele and his experiments in the camp | Auschwitz-Birkenau
sources.relevance: Official Auschwitz Memorial transcript gives the cross-matching and transfusion explanation for the legend.
